title: Attack montage with sections and a Hit notify
prompt: Make an attack montage {root}/AM_Attack from /Game/Characters/Mannequins/Anims/Unarmed/Attack/MM_Attack_01 in the DefaultSlot slot (DefaultGroup), with three sections: Windup at 0 s, Strike at 0.4 s and Recover at 0.9 s (played in that order), and a named notify Hit at 0.45 s that the Animation Blueprint can react to (AnimNotify_Hit).

tools.name: montage of MM_Attack_01 in DefaultSlot
tools.expect: r['success'] and r['class'] == 'AnimMontage' and any(t['slot'] == 'DefaultSlot' and any(s['sequence'].endswith('MM_Attack_01') for s in t['segments']) for t in r['slots'])

tools.name: sections Windup 0 -> Strike 0.4 -> Recover 0.9
tools.expect: r['success'] and [(s['name'], round(s['time'], 2)) for s in r['sections']] == [('Windup', 0), ('Strike', 0.4), ('Recover', 0.9)] and r['sections'][0]['next'] == 'Strike' and r['sections'][1]['next'] == 'Recover'

tools.name: Hit notify near 0.45 s
tools.expect: r['success'] and any(n['name'] == 'Hit' and abs(n['time'] - 0.45) < 0.05 for n in r['notifies'])
